verdict.rationale: GitHub's mobile page states that you can review pull requests, comment, approve and merge from the phone, and adds Copilot code review on mobile. Hands-on community reports confirm that PR review is used in the app but describe usability friction: diff lines wrap on Android, per-commit review is awkward, and there is no push notification when you are asked to review a PR. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on review mechanics (inline comments, suggested changes, review states), a comfortable diff view on small screens, and review-request notifications.
